description:
Your workouts, food and progress—together.

Kinetta brings activity tracking, food logging and progress into one place. Record or import workouts, save meals you make often, follow your own history and choose what to share.

WORKOUTS
Record outdoor runs, walks and rides with GPS on iPhone. Time indoor sessions, log lifting sets and reps, or follow a running plan. Import supported workouts from Apple Health after choosing what Kinetta may read. Maps, heart rate and other details depend on what each recording or import provides.

FOOD AND KIT
Log by search, barcode or chat with Kit. Mention your weight in the same message, and review both before saving. Ask Kit about past meals and weigh-ins.

PROGRESS
Compare distance, time and nutrition over time. Log weigh-ins and follow your weight trend. See every sport's achievement levels: what you've earned and what's next. Achievement levels come from recorded activities and stay private unless you choose to share them. Estimates depend on your records and are not medical advice.

FRIENDS
Find friends, cheer activities and leave comments. Choose Only me, Friends or Everyone for each activity. Shared routes trim the start and end using your privacy settings; the remaining route can still reveal location clues. Food entries, weigh-ins and private notes are not shared.

HEALTH AND OPTIONAL AI
On iPhone, connect Apple Health to import supported workouts and, separately, body-weight readings. Choose which supported categories to allow; Kinetta only imports records Apple Health makes available. Kit’s optional AI features require an eligible account and your consent before relevant food descriptions, photos or selected records are sent to the configured provider. Health and Garmin data have separate choices. Review estimates and proposed changes before confirming them.

Kinetta is for people 16 or older. Kit is for people 18 or older. An account on a Kinetta server is required; enrollment and optional services depend on that server. Some recording and Apple Health features require the iPhone app. You can export your data or delete your account in Settings.
